## Goal
Create a polished narrow mobile-web version of the selected Amber learning workspace in French. Use case ui-mockup. Portrait full-page scroll composition; aim for390 CSS-pixel proportions on a tall canvas. Render only the app interface, no phone bezel, desk, browser chrome, side-by-side screens or landscape frame.

## Context Pointers
The attached desktop Amber image is the visual authority for type character, neutral white ground, charcoal copy, amber current-action band/buttons, green completion checks, pale-blue return support and restrained rounded boundaries. Reflow for touch rather than shrinking desktop columns. This is the same product for learners generally. All content is illustrative. The French goal/step are pre-authored localized example-template content, not automatic translation of user material.

## Constraints
Create ONE coherent vertically scrolling single-column mobile screen with large readable French text and generous touch targets. Persistent compact top bar: PanelLeftOpen icon trigger (rounded rectangle with left divider and RIGHT chevron, never hamburger), outlined-square logo placeholder plus "Nom de l'app", FR control, theme moon button and account M. Use two aligned rows if needed for readable tap targets. These are unbranded placeholders. Sidebar is CLOSED in this image; no visible desktop rail. Use single-column mobile content. A small lower settings line can label the control "Mode sombre" visibly OFF. No duplicated top navigation.
First show small "Exemple de parcours" and goal "Créer une page web simple".
Dominant pale-amber next-step area: heading "Votre prochaine étape"; quiet text "Étape 4 sur 8"; task "Ajouter un titre et un paragraphe"; "Durée estimée : 10 minutes". Primary filled amber button black text "Commencer une séance". Two quiet actions "Reprendre avec 5 minutes" and "Modifier l'étape". Keep these actionable and readable, not squeezed side by side.
Then pale-blue comeback support: "Votre travail terminé est conservé." and action "Revoir les dates".
Then a quiet progress section: "3 étapes terminées sur 8"; exactly EIGHT positions with first THREE completed/filled and the remaining FIVE neutral, plus "Voir les 8 étapes". Do not draw a misleading percentage or label all steps complete.
Consistency: "3 jours d'étude"; "Du 1er au 7 octobre 2026"; "Africa/Lagos". Seven activity markers labeled1 2 3 4 5 6 7, only firstTHREE marked studied. Keep date labels clear; no streak flames or missed-day failure styling.
Personal cycle row "Après la séance" with "Bilan personnel facultatif".
Peer section "Étudier ensemble"; "Cercle privé · Facultatif"; button "Prévisualiser un engagement". This follows the study/progress flow and remains optional, not a chat tab.
Footer "Maquette · Données d'exemple".
A vertical full-page composition can extend below the first phone viewport: never truncate needed support or shrink everything just to fit one viewport. No bottom overlay hiding content, no photography, no fabricated notification, no AI, security, offline or mastery claims. Preserve all accents, apostrophes and readable line breaks.

## Done When
A distinctive Amber mobile-web design with French typography, a single dominant next action, retained progress, a clear return option and optional personal/peer support. Counts and labels are coherent. It is a static layout proposal; it does not claim real320px reflow, native-speaker validation or accessible behavior.
